mentions.name: Game-oriented programming language concept
mentions.description: A proposed programming language designed from the ground up for game development that would remove the need to care about hardware. Currently at the brainstorming/idea stage, with the author working through the design by rubber-duckying.
mentions.source_excerpt: all of this is making me want for a better programming language designed from the ground up for games, with no need to care about hardware, so I've been brainstorming and rubber-duckying about that as well.
